key_insight: Constraining each orbital’s effective potential to depend on the density excluding that orbital removes self-interaction and satisfies the generalized Koopmans condition.
engineering_relevance: More accurate fundamental band gaps could improve electronic-material screening using LDA and GGA density functional calculations.
method: Make the Kohn–Sham formulation explicitly orbital-density dependent.
Constrain each orbital’s effective potential to depend on n − n_i.
Require energy linearity under orbital-density variation to satisfy the generalized Koopmans condition.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports approximately 1 eV reductions in fundamental-band-gap mean absolute errors for LDA and GGA relative to conventional KS-DFT.
watch_item: The abstract does not specify benchmark materials, computational overhead, or convergence behavior, leaving practical scalability unclear.
paper_title: Exact subtraction of electron self-interaction from the Kohn-Sham equations
